findings.claim: Current GetConvertData constructs local entries with FillWord and SmartFuzzy, conditionally starts generation, sorts candidates through LTR, and conditionally creates cloud requests/fuses cloud results. Objective-C conversion precedes platform cloud preparation. These are static branches, not a runtime trace.

FeatureSortHandlerLm::SortByFeatures calls LMInferWithCloudCache; this appends cached cloud candidates, requests scores and calculates LM score features. The synchronous score implementation reaches GetEntryScoreImpl, which checks LocalLanguageModel::IsAttach and calls LocalLanguageModel::GetScore. A named cloud-cache function does not itself establish a network call.

Local LM loader constructs lanmodel.xnet; AttachModel calls AttachModelXNet, which constructs InferenceEngineXNetLMIncremental. Separate feature ranker loader constructs model.lm.xnet. Neither name establishes a public checkpoint or parameter count.

Generation checks enablement and IsNeedGenerateCand before RunGenerateCand. RunGenerateCand contains a std::thread constructor. Loader references encoder/decoder XNet and two SentencePiece files. Generation is a separate conditional capability, not evidence that every key invokes a general chat LLM.

XNet LM predicate accepts numeric applied modes 4/5. UpdateDeviceModelEnable sets the generation-enable field for modes 5/6; generation getter additionally rejects an unnamed suppression flag. Active mode, remote assignment and enum meanings remain unobserved.

Local conversion and cloud-candidate preparation precede conditional platform request. Kernel setting index 0x39 defaults to 1 in currentCloudSendType. Platform request arbitration checks channel/circuit-breaker policy. Neither enabled account preferences nor network payloads were inspected.

Installed version differs from earlier 1.0.6.13398. Current functions were re-disassembled rather than reusing old addresses. The core roles above persist, but no comprehensive binary diff or claim of complete behavioral equivalence is made.

None of the six referenced XNet/SentencePiece names or .xnet/.gguf/.safetensors/.onnx files were found in the current installed app bundle. No current user-support directories inspected; external provisioning and active models remain unresolved.
